description: This file defines binary operations for MaskedTensor objects in PyTorch, including support for sparse tensor formats and in-place operations. It imports core utilities and registers binary functions with torch's aten operations.

methods.name: _get_at_least_one_mask
methods.description: Retrieves the mask from either of two MaskedTensor objects, ensuring they match.

methods.name: _binary_helper
methods.description: Performs binary operations on MaskedTensor objects, handling sparse formats and in-place modifications.

methods.name: _torch_binary
methods.description: Creates a binary function for torch operations that is not in-place.

methods.name: _torch_inplace_binary
methods.description: Creates an in-place binary function for torch operations.

methods.name: _is_native_binary
methods.description: Checks if a function is a registered native binary operation.

methods.name: _apply_native_binary
methods.description: Applies a native binary operation, either in-place or not, based on the function.
